items.title: Nordson (NDSN) Stock Looks Hard To Call On A 44% Run
items.summary: Nordson has delivered a strong multi year share price run, and that kind of climb naturally raises a question about whether today's US$322.34 price is supported by the cash the business can generate. The issue now is whether the current market value lines up with what its future cash flows can reasonably justify. items.title: 3 Dividend Aristocrats With the Most Room to Keep Raising Their Dividends
items.summary: Some S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats raise their payouts every year mostly out of habit, but a few have payout ratios so low that a rough recession barely threatens the next increase. Three names on the roster stand out for the sheer amount of room they have left to run.
